 Formula One 2026 São Paulo Formula One Grand Prix qualifying in Brazil – live again after a red flag
 🏎️ Updates from the Interlagos (session starts 6pm GMT)
 🏎️ Sign up for The Recap newsletter | And email Philip 
 LIVE  Updated  2m ago Philip Cornwall Sat 7 Nov 2026 15.22 EST First published on Sat 7 Nov 2026 12.00 EST Share Key events 18m ago Drop zone – including Oscar Piastri 
 39m ago Q1 eliminations 
 3h ago Preamble 
 Charles Leclerc on track during qualifying. Photograph: Bradley Collyer/PA View image in fullscreen Charles Leclerc on track during qualifying. Photograph: Bradley Collyer/PA Philip Cornwall Sat 7 Nov 2026 15.22 EST First published on Sat 7 Nov 2026 12.00 EST Share Key events 18m ago Drop zone – including Oscar Piastri 
 39m ago Q1 eliminations 
 3h ago Preamble 
 1m ago 15.22 EST Everyone back in the pits. The clock ticking, barely four minutes left.
 Share 2m ago 15.21 EST Russell furious at being told to back off, because Albon was in the way, but then the rain came. Toto Wolff trying to console him.
 Share 3m ago 15.20 EST Norris, Russell, Antonelli , Leclerc, Lawson, Hulkenberg, Hadjar, Bearman, Alonso, Albon.
 Share 4m ago 15.19 EST Ted Kravitz says the heavy rain is here. That could be that.
 Share 5m ago 15.19 EST Norris takes it as of right in 1:27.470.
 Share 5m ago 15.19 EST Russell has that penalty … so Norris could inherit pole.
 Share 5m ago 15.18 EST It all depends on the rain. Russell quickest in 1:27.674, from Norris, Lawson, Antonelli.
 Share 6m ago 15.17 EST Nope. Liam Lawson goes much faster and so does Lando Norris.
 Share 8m ago 15.15 EST Fernando Alonso out in front. He must have a shot at pole.
 Share 9m ago 15.15 EST “When it hits , it will be very intense,” Antonelli is told.
 Share 10m ago 15.14 EST Q3 is go. But for how long?
 Share Updated at  15.14 EST 10m ago 15.13 EST Antonelli told we might get only one lap before the heavy rain returns. Is everyone in the queue on the wrong tyres?
 Share 11m ago 15.12 EST Karun Chandhok says Piastri stayed out maybe two laps too long.
 Share 12m ago 15.11 EST A pit lane queue is forming. We might – might – get away with it.
 Share 13m ago 15.10 EST Bernie Collins says the rain looks to be five minutes away. Camara damaged a barrier, it will take time to repair, and Q3 could be in doubt.
 Share 15m ago 15.09 EST “Weather update: very dark now,” says George Russell.
 View image in fullscreen Sidelights, at least. Photograph: Clive Mason/Getty Images Share Updated at  15.15 EST 17m ago 15.06 EST Q3 will be delayed . Q2 will not restart. Albon and Alonso among those through, the latter Aston Martin’s first of the season.
 Share 18m ago 15.05 EST Drop zone – including Oscar Piastri
 Camara’s crash sends out Hamilton, Piastri, Camara, Lindblad, Sainz and non-runner Verstappen.
 Share 20m ago 15.04 EST Red flag. Camara in the wall.
 Share 21m ago 15.03 EST Like Q1 , it’s a tale of endless improvement.
 Share 23m ago 15.01 EST Bearman goes fastest , then Lawson in 1:27.478.
 Share 23m ago 15.00 EST Now everyone. Drop zone is Camara, Lindblad, Sainz, Bearman, Albon and non-runner Verstappen.
 View image in fullscreen Rafael Camara goes off-piste. Photograph: NurPhoto/Shutterstock Share Updated at  15.02 EST 25m ago 14.58 EST Intermediates. Alonso, Lawson and others.
 Share 26m ago 14.58 EST No , he was able to stop behind the barriers.
 Share 26m ago 14.57 EST Red flag coming? Lindblad told to “stop the car in a safe place”.
 Share 27m ago 14.57 EST Antonelli at +0.359.
 Share 28m ago 14.55 EST Hamilton second fastest for a moment, but Russell lands a 1:29.285.
 Share 29m ago 14.54 EST Leclerc gets a 1:29.795. Keen to get as far away as possible from Hamilton.
 Share 31m ago 14.53 EST Russell gets a 1:30 , then Antonelli faster still, then Norris.
 Share 31m ago 14.52 EST Russell says he needs to stay on full wets, despite some areas looking good for intermediates.
 View image in fullscreen We say he does… Photograph: Buda Mendes/Getty Images Share Updated at  14.59 EST 33m ago 14.51 EST Bernie Collins says the weather will get better and better. So more of the same, perhaps.
 Share 34m ago 14.50 EST Q2 is go – and without Max Verstappen. He has a time to avoid being 22nd and needs to preserve his tyres.
 Share 36m ago 14.48 EST Karun Chandhok replays Camara’s impact and praises the Haas car for being strong enough that with a patch-up he made Q2.
 Share 37m ago 14.47 EST Bortoleto slid across the grass, recovered, but the rear wing could not be fixed.
 Share 38m ago 14.46 EST Well that was worth waiting for. Totally bizarre racing, lap after lap after lap of new people going fastest.
 Share 39m ago 14.44 EST Q1 eliminations
 Out go Colapinto, Gasly, Stroll, Bottas, Perez and Bortoleto. Bortoleto finding the grass was decisive.
 Share 40m ago 14.43 EST Norris fastest , and Rafa Camara gets 13th place! Q2 on debut!
 Share 41m ago 14.42 EST Yellow flag … Russell, Verstappen and Hamilton go ahead of Hulkenberg.
 View image in fullscreen Lewis Hamilton on the move. Photograph: Alessio Morgese/ZUMA/Shutterstock Share Updated at  14.47 EST 42m ago 14.41 EST “It could be wild,” says Brundle. Whoever runs last has a chance. Cross that line in time to start a final lap …
 Share 43m ago 14.40 EST Hulkenberg fastest again! Drop zone is now Perez, Sainz, Stroll, Bottas, Colapinto, Bortoleto.
 Share 44m ago 14.39 EST Russell’s 1:32.441 is followed by Norris, +0.356, then Antonelli, +0.361.
 Share 45m ago 14.38 EST Verstappen pulls out a 1:33.074, ahead of Bearman, Lawson, Lindblad. But then Russell betters the Red Bull, as do Norris and Antonelli.
 View image in fullscreen George Russell in the Mercedes. Photograph: Bradley Collyer/PA Share Updated at  14.45 EST 47m ago 14.37 EST And Antonelli gets himself out of trouble, up to fourth.
 Share 47m ago 14.37 EST Antonelli doesn’t have a proper time. Drop zone is Stroll, Colapinto, Bearman, Bortoleto and Camara.
 Share 48m ago 14.35 EST George Russell 1st, now Norris second. The lead is changing hands so much as conditions improve.
 Share 49m ago 14.35 EST Hulkenberg now fastest in 1:35.477. Drivers adapting. Hamilton now P1 with 1:34.373.
 Share 50m ago 14.34 EST Bortoleto in the grass but escapes. Phew.
 Share 50m ago 14.33 EST “You are living on your wits,” avers Brundle.
 Share 51m ago 14.33 EST This is chaos. Verstappen 1:36.724, Leclerc +0.025, then Alonso!
 Share 52m ago 14.31 EST Verstappen in a 1:37.932. Leclerc may have lost a time.
 Share 54m ago 14.30 EST 1:40.512 from Hulkenberg.
 Share 54m ago 14.29 EST Yellow flag … Rafa Camara, the new man in Haas. But he got going again.
 Share 55m ago 14.28 EST Bottas is the first man on a timed lap. “You might need a calendar rather than a stopwatch,” says Brundle.
 Share 1h ago 14.27 EST Mercedes still sitting in the garage.
 Share 1h ago 14.27 EST Brundle observes that everyone is leaving a gap to the car in front. You want some visbility.
 Share 1h ago 14.26 EST But cars are going out.
 Share 1h ago 14.26 EST “It’s pretty heavy,” says Piastri.
